changes.text: Another approach, and this is the author's counterfactual rather than history, would have been to compare average death rates by district, or rich districts against poor ones. Wealth, housing and occupation would then have crowded in, and the effect of the water would have been hard to separate out. What Snow actually did was more laborious. He inquired himself into every cholera death in the districts the Lambeth Company supplied: death addresses, house by house, and, where needed, water carried home in phials. Some districts supplied only by the Southwark and Vauxhall Company, such as Bermondsey, were covered for the first four weeks by a medical man, Mr Whiting. In some of those sub-districts the figures for the last three weeks were calculated in the same proportion as in the first four weeks. This yielded two things. One was counts of deaths by water supply for houses in the same intermixed streets. The other was a company-wide comparison per 10,000 houses.

dispositions.rationale: 英文原句丢掉了中文“必要时”的限定。按证据，斯诺只在住户说不清供水公司时才取水样。现已在英文中加入“where needed”，与中文一致。中文字段原本准确，未改动。

evidence.quote: when the resident could not give clear and conclusive evidence about the Water Company, I obtained some of the water in a small phial
